d: In a major legislative move ahead of a special Parliament sitting beginning November 30, 2026, the Union Cabinet chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi has cleared an amended Constitution Amendment Bill on delimitation. Under the revised proposal, seats across all States will see a proportionate 50% increase—a ratio set to remain frozen for 25 years until the Census after 2051—while bringing Women’s Reservation into effect simultaneously.
